message.content:
**Traffic Laws in Texas – A Quick Reference Guide** | Topic | Key Points | Where to Find More Info | |-------|------------|------------------------| | **Speed Limits** | • General limit: 55 mph on rural roads, 45 mph on urban roads.
• 70 mph on interstate highways (except where posted otherwise).
• 65 mph on freeways in urban areas. | Texas Department of Transportation (TxDOT) – Speed Limit Regulations | | **Seat‑belt & Child‑Safety** | • All occupants must wear seat belts.
• Children under 8 must be in a child safety seat or booster. | Texas Transportation Code §545.001 | | **Cell‑Phone Use** | • Hand‑held phone use while driving is prohibited.
• Hands‑free devices are allowed. | Texas Transportation Code §545.001 | | **Driving Under Influence (DUI)** | • Blood Alcohol Concentration (BAC) of 0.08% or higher is illegal.
• Zero‑tolerance for drivers under 21.
• Penalties include fines, license suspension, and possible jail time. | Texas Transportation Code §545.001 | | **Right‑of‑Way** | • Yield to pedestrians at crosswalks.
• Stop at stop signs and red lights.
• “Right‑of‑way” rules for intersections without signs. | Texas Transportation Code §545.001 | | **School Bus Rules** | • Vehicles must stop when a school bus is loading/unloading children.
• No passing a stopped school bus. | Texas Transportation Code §545.001 | | **Lane‑Changing & Overtaking** | • Use turn signals.
• Do not cut off other drivers. | Texas Transportation Code §545.001 | | **Parking Regulations** | • No parking in front of driveways, fire hydrants, or within 20 ft of a crosswalk.
• Pay attention to local ordinances. | Local city/town codes | | **Vehicle Registration & Inspection** | • Annual registration renewal required.
• Vehicle inspections required in some counties. | Texas Department of Motor Vehicles (TxDMV) | | **Toll Roads** | • Texas has several toll roads (e.g., Sam Houston Tollway).
• Use electronic toll tags (e‑Tag). | TxDOT Toll Roads | | **Emergency Vehicles** | • Pull over to the right and stop when an emergency vehicle with flashing lights approaches. | Texas Transportation Code §545.001 | | **Winter Driving** | • No mandatory snow tires, but vehicles must be safe for weather conditions. | TxDOT Weather Advisory | | **Penalties & Fines** | • Varies by offense; can include fines, points on license, and jail time. | Texas Transportation Code §545.001 | ### How to Get Official, Up‑to‑Date Information 1. **Texas Department of Transportation (TxDOT)** – [www.txdot.gov](https://www.txdot.gov) *Speed limits, toll roads, and road conditions.* 2. **Texas Department of Motor Vehicles (TxDMV)** – [www.txdmv.gov](https://www.txdmv.gov) *Registration, licensing, and inspection requirements.* 3. **Texas Transportation Code** – Available online through the Texas Legislature’s website or legal databases. *Full statutory text for all traffic laws.* 4. **Local City/Town Ordinances** – Check your municipality’s website for parking, speed limits, and other local rules. --- #### Quick Tips for Safe Driving in Texas - **Always obey posted speed limits** – they’re set for safety. - **Keep your seat belt fastened** – it’s a legal requirement and saves lives. - **Avoid distractions** – especially cell‑phone use. - **Know the rules for school buses** – they’re heavily enforced. - **Stay alert for toll roads** – have your e‑Tag ready. If you need more detailed information on a specific law or want to check the latest updates, let me know!
